description: Sanitized, immutable public URL and CDN media inventory of current RETALLY scheduled Facebook and Instagram campaign; source snapshot 2026-10-13. No unpublished captions, personal account names, customer records, or proofs of publication. Network probes check only reachable assets and educational routes.

mediaAltText: RETALLY premium emerald-and-black illustration explaining freight overcharge reviews in four steps: review invoices; check rates and shipment records; find billing errors; help pursue authorized recovery. Glossy black truck at a container port with an emerald network globe and raised glass step cards. Initial audit $0 upfront for agreed eligible scope.

Recover it.' $0 upfront initial audit for agreed eligible scope.

data.text: Public artwork inventory only; not a publication receipt.
mediaAltText: RETALLY branded secure-inquiry instructions: start with a conversation about freight modes and scope, agree on next steps, and share sensitive records only through an approved transfer route.
RETALLY Field Notes carousel, slide one of four: Billed for a liftgate? The invoice line alone is not the service record; check evidence supporting the extra fee.
RETALLY accessorial proof slide two: verify the governing contract or tariff, the fee trigger, included services, and the effective version.
RETALLY accessorial proof slide three: match delivery record, service notation, and shipment identity before treating a liftgate charge as questionable.
RETALLY slide four: three questions before a dispute—what terms governed, what documents support the service, and whether a correction or credit already occurred.
